description: Search CONFIRMED-SOLD equipment lots on bigiron.com for comps — title, make/model/year, quantity, seller, location and close date for lots that actually sold. IMPORTANT: bigiron.com does not expose the realized hammer price in this page shape (verified: 0/100 sampled sold lots carry a nonzero price field, even with 60+ bids) — final_price is always null with an explanatory note; num_bids is the closest available demand signal. Use bigiron_search for current asking prices instead. Sourced from bigiron.com/Search?filter=Sold.

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (each page holds up to 20 lots)
